Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 28, 2026

VibeNMED is a professional networking and discovery platform for nursing and medical-education roles operated by CloudDropDesigns LLC ("Company," "we," "us," or "our"). The App helps users discover, match with, and message other users. It is not a clinical placement agency, employer, school, credentialing body, background-check provider, or HIPAA-covered medical records system.

This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you use the VibeNMED mobile application and related services (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

Interpretation and Definitions

Definitions

For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

  • Account means a unique account created for you to access the Service.
  • Application or App means VibeNMED, the mobile application provided by the Company.
  • Calendar Data means rotation-related events you enter in the App, including titles, dates, and times.
  • Company refers to CloudDropDesigns LLC, California, United States.
  • Matched Users means users who have mutually connected for in-app messaging.
  • Personal Data means any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
  • PHI means protected health information about patients or other individuals, as defined under applicable U.S. health privacy laws. You must not submit PHI through the Service.
  • Professional Profile Data means education, role, NPI number, bio, photos, and other non-patient profile information you provide.
  • Service means the Application and related features we operate.
  • Service Provider means a third party that processes data on our behalf to operate the Service.
  • Usage Data means data collected automatically through use of the Service (for example, device type, IP address, and diagnostic logs).
  • Verification Documents means compliance-related files you upload (such as BLS cards or immunization records relating to you). These are user-provided files, not medical records created by us.
  • You means the individual using the Service, or the entity on whose behalf that individual uses the Service.

Information We Collect

Information You Provide

  • Email address, phone number, and account identifiers
  • Name, profile details, and Professional Profile Data
  • Photos and profile images
  • Verification Documents you choose to upload
  • Messages and content you send through the App
  • Safety or abuse reports you submit
  • Calendar Data and, if you enable email sync, the email address you provide for that feature
  • Approximate location when you grant permission

Information Collected Automatically

We may collect Usage Data such as device type, operating system, IP address, app version, push notification tokens, and diagnostic information needed to operate and secure the Service.

Information from Third-Party Sources

If you use Google Sign-In or Sign in with Apple, we receive account identifiers according to those providers' policies. If you enter an NPI number, we may query the public CMS NPI Registry through our backend to help pre-fill profile fields. We do not endorse your eligibility to practice or precept based on NPI data.

Device Permissions

With your permission, the App may access your camera, photo library, and location. You can change these permissions in your device settings.

How We Use Your Information

We use Personal Data to:

  • Provide and maintain the Service, including accounts, matching, profiles, and messaging
  • Process Verification Documents and display document status in the App
  • Perform administrative completeness review of uploads — not clinical clearance, credentialing, or background-check verification
  • Send optional calendar email updates and reminders when you enable email sync
  • Deliver push notifications about account and app activity
  • Respond to support requests and enforce our Terms of Service
  • Improve security, prevent abuse, and analyze aggregated usage trends

The in-app shop is for browsing only; in-app purchases are not enabled at this time. We do not use your data to process in-app product purchases.

How We Share Your Information

  • With Matched Users: profile information you choose to display and messages you send through the App
  • With Service Providers: companies that help us operate the Service, including Google Firebase (authentication, database, file storage, and cloud functions), Stream Chat (messaging), Expo (push notifications), and Google/Apple (optional sign-in). Each provider processes data under its own privacy policy.
  • With administrators: authorized Company personnel who review Verification Documents and safety reports
  • For legal reasons: when required by law, court order, or to protect rights, safety, and security
  • Business transfers: in connection with a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, with notice where required

We do not sell your Personal Data. Other users cannot download your raw Verification Document files unless a feature explicitly allows you to share them and you choose to do so.

Sensitive Information and PHI

CloudDropDesigns LLC is not a HIPAA-covered entity, and the App is not intended as a medical record system or patient chart repository.

You must not submit PHI — including patient names, medical record numbers, diagnoses, treatment notes, or other patient-identifying health information — in profiles, messages, calendar entries, or Verification Document uploads.

Upload only your own professional and compliance documents. Do not upload another person's personal or health information without their consent.

Verification Documents

If you upload Verification Documents:

  • Files are transmitted to our backend and stored using Google Firebase Storage in the United States
  • We store metadata such as document type, file name, upload date, and review status
  • Authorized administrators may access files for administrative review
  • Status labels such as "Reviewed" or "On file" reflect administrative completeness review only — not clinical clearance or third-party acceptance
  • We retain documents while your account is active and as needed to operate the Service, resolve disputes, or comply with law. You may request deletion by deleting your account or contacting us

Calendar and Email Sync

Calendar events are stored in your app session on your device. If you enable email sync, we transmit your Calendar Data and the email address you provide to our cloud functions to send calendar updates and optional reminders.

Do not enter patient-identifying information in calendar fields. If you use a work email address, your employer may monitor that mailbox under its own policies.

You can disable email sync in the App at any time.

Data Retention

We retain Personal Data only as long as needed for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including operating the Service, meeting legal obligations, resolving disputes, and enforcing our agreements. Usage Data is generally retained for a shorter period unless needed for security or functionality improvements.

Data Security and Transfer

We use commercially reasonable safeguards to protect Personal Data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your information may be processed in the United States and other locations where our Service Providers operate. By using the Service, you consent to this processing where permitted by law.

Your Rights and Choices

You may update or delete certain information in account settings. You may delete your account from within the App. You may contact us to request access, correction, or deletion of Personal Data you have provided.

California residents may have additional rights to know, delete, and correct Personal Data, and to opt out of certain sharing. Contact us at cloud@clouddropdesigns.com to exercise these rights.

We may retain certain information when we have a legal obligation or lawful basis to do so.

Children's Privacy

The Service is intended for users 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has provided us data, contact us and we will take steps to delete it.

Third-Party Services

The App uses the following third-party services. Each processes data according to its own privacy policy:

  • Google Firebase — Firebase Privacy
  • Google Sign-In — Google Privacy Policy
  • Sign in with Apple — Apple Privacy Policy
  • Stream Chat — Stream Privacy Policy
  • Expo Push Notifications — Expo Privacy Policy

Links to Other Websites

The Service may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices. Review their policies before providing information.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated version with a revised "Last updated" date and, when appropriate, notify you by email or in-app notice before changes take effect.

Contact Us

Questions about this Privacy Policy:

  • Email: cloud@clouddropdesigns.com
